population: Public itch.io operator and marketplace policy records, not publishers, sales or shareholder register
unit: dated official publication or independently attributable operator statement
sample_frame: Official operator launch/changelog and public legal/policy documents

dated_events.summary: Initial customizable game/project publication and optional minimum game prices
First-party collected payout/VAT handling option announced; separate from direct payments
Seller-configurable 0–100% open revenue sharing announced with future activation
Owner project exposure reports distinguish thumbnail impressions and clickthrough from paid game orders
Itch Corp. named in 2026 privacy policy with modification date; not a corporate share ledger
Official changelog covers sale explorer and co-op bundle publishing/payout interfaces, alongside external Patreon membership integration

acquisition_audit.search_scope: Public first-party founder FAQ, contractual operator, and dated policy/update record for potential changes of control; no comprehensive corporate filing search

interpretation_rules: Feature launch dates and later effective dates are separate.
An operator identity named in legal terms is not audited equity or beneficial ownership.
A historical mention of a payment service is not proof that it is available in 2026.
A changelog describing sale features is not platform GMV, developer profits, unique buyers or paid transactions.
No confirmed acquisition event in the consulted official record is an evidence gap, not proof of no acquisition.
